## summarizeObservations() function

Summarizes a group of Observations into a single computed summary value, with the individual values preserved in `Observation.component.valueSampledData`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function summarizeObservations(observations: Observation[] | Bundle<Observation>, summaryCode: CodeableConcept, summarizeFn: StatsFn): Observation;
```
